conf.description: GitLab (self-managed) gitlab-shell / json: JSON extract, strip the user- prefix from user_id so it joins the numeric user.id used by api/audit, copy correlation_id to both event.id and trace.id, event.duration in nanoseconds, batched clean-path rename; no client IP on this feed by design.

conf.comment: gitlab-self-managed / gitlab-shell / json (gitlab-shell.log, logrus JSON). Hand-built pipeline: no Elastic integration data stream and no vendor pack cover gitlab-shell.log, so this is normalisation only (no grammar parsing beyond JSON extract). user_id arrives prefixed (user-1) unlike the bare numeric user_id on api_json.log/audit_json.log - stripped here so the same person correlates across datasets. correlation_id is also copied to trace.id so an SSH push can be joined to the api_json.log lines it triggered. gitlab-shell.log carries no client IP in either grammar; SSH source attribution needs the host's own sshd auth log correlated on time+username, which is a gap in this feed, not this parser. _raw dropped after extraction since every documented field is captured.

functions.description: record approach and the honest source-IP gap
parse the logrus JSON line into top-level fields

compute derived fields from the original vendor names before renaming: ISO time to _time, de-prefixed user id, event.duration in nanoseconds, correlation id copied to both event.id and trace.id, dataset tag
batch every clean-path status:mapped/unmapped-with-custom-target field that needed no further transform
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
